questions.questionText:
Consider the graph of a power function f, shown below.

Which one of the following represents the graph f?
options: f(x) = x³⁄₂
f(x) = x⁴⁄₃
f(x) = x²⁄₃
f(x) = x¹⁄₃
questions.explanation:
Given f(x) = x²⁄₃.
 At x = 8, f(8) = 8²⁄₃ 

= (∛8)² = 2² = 4.

 At x = -8, f(-8) = (-8)²⁄₃=
 (∛(-8))² =
 (-2)² = 4.

 Therefore, the graph passes through the points (8, 4) and (-8, 4).

 Hence, option C is correct.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is true about homogeneity of system of linear equations?
options:
x − 2y = 0
3x + 4y = 0 is a nonhomogeneous system of linear equations.

x + y = 0
x + 2y + 3z = 0
z = 0 is a nonhomogeneous system of linear equations.

x − 2y + 4z = 0
3x + 2y + 9z = 0 is a homogeneous system of linear equations.

x − 2y − 1 = 0
x + 2y − 3 = 0
x − z + 5 = 0 is a homogeneous system of linear equations.
questions.explanation:
A homogeneous system has all constant terms equal to 0. 

=> In C, x−2y+4z=0 and 3x+2y+9z=0, so it is homogeneous.

questions.questionText: What is the area of a triangle with vertices A(0, 0), B(1, -3) and C(5, 1) (in square units)?
Which one of the following quantities represents scalar?
options: The direction of a wind, measured by wind vane.
Speed of a car observed on speedometer.
The direction and distance moved by a bullet.
Force applied to lift damaged car from main road.
questions.explanation:
Speed is a scalar quantity because it has magnitude only and no direction.

 Therefore, the speed of a car observed on a speedometer is scalar.

questions.questionText: When the circle (x - 3)² + (y - 1)² = 1 is reflected on a line y = 2x, then the image of the circle is
questions.explanation:
Center = (3,1).
 Reflect (3,1) across y=2x 
⇒ (-1,3).

 Radius remains 1.

 Therefore, (x+1)²+(y-3)²=1.

questions.questionText:
In a certain entrance examination, the following data of results is recorded: 
12, 19, 15, 22, 53, 61, 57, 22, 18 
 68, 72, 80, 83, 75, 76, 85, 85.

 Then, which one of the following is true about the data?
options: The first quartile, Q₁ of the data is 21.
The second quartile, Q₂ of the data is 61.
The third quartile, Q₃ of the data is 76.
The value of Q₃ - Q₁ is 55.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is NOT true about the mode of the given data?
options: The data 4, 6, 7, 9, 3, 5, 4 is unimodal.
The data 4, 2, 7, 9, 7, 2 is bimodal.
The data 2, 4, 9, 3, 9, 5, 3, 4, 2 is multimodal.
The data 12, 12, 12, 12, 12 has no mode.
questions.explanation: D is NOT true because 12 occurs 5 times, so the data has a mode: Mode = 12.

questions.questionText: In how many different ways can 6 people be seated at a round table?
questions.explanation:
For n people seated at a round table:

 (n−1)! =
 (6−1)! =
 5! =
 120.

questions.questionText: An outcome of random experiment is said to be favorable outcome if
options: it has equal chance of being chosen.
it insures the occurrence of particular result.
it is the set of all possible results of the experiment.
it can be predicted in advance.
questions.explanation: A favorable outcome is an outcome that ensures the occurrence of a particular result.
